items.label: [SSA] Check Reddit site status
items.description: Check for active Reddit incidents at the configured severity

items.label: [SSA] Send test outage alerts
items.description: Send clearly marked test incidents through configured notification channels

incident-filtering.label: Incident filtering
incident-filtering.helpText: Choose which Reddit incidents are important enough to receive notifications for.

minimumIncidentSeverity.label: Minimum incident severity
minimumIncidentSeverity.helpText: Incidents below this Statuspage severity are ignored. Records with no severity and maintenance notices are also ignored.

discord-notifications.label: Discord notifications
discord-notifications.helpText: Get Discord notifications about site incidents.

discordWebhookUrl.label: Discord webhook URL
discordWebhookUrl.helpText: Paste a webhook URL copied from a Discord channel's Integrations settings.

slack-notifications.label: Slack notifications
slack-notifications.helpText: Get Slack notifications about site incidents.

slackWebhookUrl.label: Slack incoming webhook URL
slackWebhookUrl.helpText: Paste an incoming webhook URL copied from your Slack app's settings.

modmail-notifications.label: Modmail notifications
modmail-notifications.helpText: Send native Reddit Modmail notifications about site incidents.

modmailNotificationsEnabled.label: Enable Modmail notifications
modmailNotificationsEnabled.helpText: Send active incident and resolution alerts to this subreddit's Modmail.
